title: Stonehenge Altar Stone as a lightning rod
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Stonehenge Altar Stone as a lightning rod, about Neolithic at Stonehenge, England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then you have the alter stone of Stonehenge which was the lightning rod, the obelisk.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien revealed to him the true purpose of ancient monuments, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the Altar Stone at Stonehenge, the ancient stone circle in England, was a lightning rod. He calls it an obelisk, a tall standing stone, and treats it, if he is right, as part of an energy system rather than a place of worship.
